import * as echarts from 'echarts'

export const meta = {
  title: 'Repeated radius',
  kind: 'chart',
}

export function mount(el, ctx) {
  const chart = echarts.init(el)
  chart.setOption({ series: [{ type: 'bar', itemStyle: { borderRadius: 0 }, label: { borderRadius: 8 } }] })
  return () => chart.dispose()
}
